translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Yesu kaliva wayafunena gikoyo-moꞋa ma gikiveyamumuna.
Tu Yesu ana tomuliya buye Galili ana tobu yuwa fafaline hidamana be miGadala yadi fafaliya hiyemu.
Yesu wakeya gihobu tu kaliva saꞋeyana wayafunena aiboꞋuveya gitauya be Bana amine giꞋela.

Bana kalivai-nadi aiboꞋuveya giveꞋabaga ada keke tamo hakwadi anafaiweya bulava againe ginayogoni, higa-wayoga. FaꞋina bulava kainumula nonogana gidobona. E, nimana kadu agena bulava kainumula againe hiyogoyogona tova a gavaiyehi tu gififaiwala be bulava nimane giꞋatudobodobona, kadu bulava agene giꞋutudobodobona. Keke tamo hakwadi anafaiweya ginahawatani, au kaliva moyaꞋaidi gifaiwalahegedi.
Bogi uyadayada aiboꞋuveya kadu oyeya ginunudadana gikovakovaꞋawafatafata, kuga againe tauna gitalatalana.

Au kaliva aimo lauveya giꞋelaꞋela tu Yesu gidaꞋitana ma gimadu Bana agene giꞋiboꞋula-moꞋa gikovaꞋawafatafata agona lakahina gigayo, “Yesu, OꞋeni Yaubada Getane-moꞋane Natuna. Gavadi iya agaikuya unagani-yo uꞋela? Iya gaveꞋoꞋole, Yaubada matane unagahe be higa keke unakivetavetagigiku.”
Hidede amine gigahe faꞋina Yesu yafune gimidigahena gigayo, “O yafune hida kaliva unanuyabuyabuna.”
Bana kaliva gigahe-yo, Yesu gitoliyena gigayo, “Gavaimi a egana?” Bana gigayo, “Aku egana YoꞋo, faꞋina ime yafune moyaꞋaima kaliva aluvaiyena.”
Ada Yesu againe giveꞋoꞋoladona gigayo, “Yafune keke unawavidi be hida fafali hinanuyabuyabuni.”
Tu yuwa oya fafaline bawe adi yoꞋo lakahina adiga hilelele faꞋina yafune hihawayafeyafena higayo, “Udavehimeyema be yuwa bawe agaidiya unawavima-yo analuvaiyedi.”
Au gihawahegedi ada yafune kaliva hinuyabuyabuni-yo bawe hiluvaiyedi, au bawe adi yoꞋo luhei tausani (2,000) amine ma awaloloya hiꞋotahobu, tobu againe hitowaꞋalika.
Tu bawe adi tolufolofologahi hiꞋota be hina melala-moꞋena kadu awaꞋawanine mena gaitomai-dina hilukahihiyedi. Ada kaliva vevine hitauya be gavadi gilakayemu-ma hinaꞋitana.

Ada Yesu againe hiꞋela kaliva wayafunena hiꞋitana, medede againe gihiyoto uꞋuna a giyamumu be ana kaleko giꞋosena, boi yafune moyaꞋaidi adi egana YoꞋo hiluvaiyena-ma kalivai-nadi. HiꞋita-yo himatautaveꞋine.
Ada badi toꞋita gavadi kaliva boi wayafunena kadu bawe agaidiya gilakayemu-ma hilukahihiyena.
Ada au hivebutu Yesu higaheyaꞋayaꞋalina be higa yadi fafali ginanuyabuyabuna.
Yesu gina wakeya giyageyage tu kaliva boi wayafunena gihawayafeyafena gigayo, “Iya O buye kadana.”
Atu Yesu gihawatana gigayo, “Una ya melaleya be a unuma agaidiya unalukahihi. Gavadi lakahina Kaiwabu o faꞋiniya gigugaiyeni kadu gavaiyaꞋamine giꞋitanuwakabubuye ma unalukahihiyedi.”
Ada au kaliva gina be givebutu gavadi lakahina bana faꞋine Yesu gigugaiyena-ma melala teni adi fafali ana egana Dekafolisi agaidiya gilukahihiyena. Ada kaliva moyaꞋaidi hinogalini-yo hiyaulowoga.
Yailo natuna kwamayoku yana aulolo kahihina.
Yesu wakeya giyage-yo kadu tobuya gidamana ada yuwa fafaline giyemu-yo yoꞋo lakahi-moꞋena taliyeya himadu Bana againe hivagaꞋauta.

Taliyeya gimiyami tu manuwa-abavehawala ana tonagona saꞋeyana giꞋela, ana egana Yailo. Ada bana tonagona Yesu giꞋita-yo agene giꞋiboꞋula-moꞋa gihawayafeyafena gigayo, “Natuku kwamayoku kabiꞋona giꞋaulolo lakahina kaꞋi ginaꞋalika. UdaꞋela nima bana againe udasena be gidabwaina, gidamiyami hagihagina.”
Au Yesu gilowoga be tonagona buye hina. Ada yoꞋo lakahina hibwaꞋulina hinauna tu Yesu liline hiveveꞋatuwahega.
Kwamayoku Yesu ana kaleko bwatana gikibwaꞋena kahihina.
Tu kwamayoku saꞋeyana yoꞋo agaidiya ginauna, bana yana vaikohi be dayagina tova moyaꞋaina gimadu-vagata. Tuwaina givebutu giꞋuꞋaulolo ada ginunauwena malamala tuwelo.

Doketa moyaꞋaidi agaidiya ginauna ada yadi lumulamula againe aulolo lakahina ginuhagana. Yana mani matatabuna badi agaidiya gihavaina. Gilulumulamula tu doketa keke adifaiweya, au yana aulolo gitubuga-moꞋa.
Yesu valeyana ahe ginogalina faꞋina yoꞋo hinafadiya Bana wamuline giꞋela be ana kaleko bwatana gikibwaꞋena.
FaꞋina nuwahinagene gigahe gigayo, “KaꞋi ana kalekogaga ganakibwaꞋena, au ganayamumu.”
GikibwaꞋeni-yo auheꞋama dayagina giꞋagolohina, ada gava wowone giꞋayaunena yana aulolo a gihavaina.
Ada Yesu yana faiwala tamo hakwadi againe gina ma giꞋayaunena, au yoꞋo hinafadiya gihagavilana gitoliluvaluva gigayo, “HakwaꞋadi aku kaleko gikibwaꞋeni?”
Ada ana tomuliya higahena higayo, “YoꞋo hiveveꞋatuwahega-ma uꞋitadi. Gavadi-yo ugahe ugayo, HakwaꞋadi aku kaleko gisibutuni?”
Tu Yesu aimo giꞋitaꞋitalele be hakwaꞋadi gikibwaꞋeni-ma ginaꞋitana.
Au kwamayoku gavadi bana againe gilakayemu-ma gihalamaneni-yo yana wamatauta yana wavetatava giꞋela, Bana agene giꞋiboꞋula-moꞋa be tauna kahihina matatabuna gilukahihiyena.
Gilukahihi gihavaina Yesu gigahena gigayo, “Natuku, uvetumaganeku faꞋina ubwaina. Ya wanuwayamumu unana ya aulolo gihavai-moꞋena.”
Yesu Yailo natuna alikeya gisivemididina.
Yesu aimo gilulukahihi tu kaliva tufoidi Yailo yana manuweya hitauya-ma hiyemu be higahena higayo, “Natu kwamayoku yawaina gihavaina. Au keke Tovehawala unaluveꞋavaleni-yo unaꞋaliye-kawowoni.”
Yesu bonadi keke gidavenogaleni, au manuwa-abavehawala ana tonagona againe gigahe gigayo, “Keke unamatauta, au unavetumaganeku.”
Ada kaliva moyaꞋaidi gihawatadi be keke hinabwaꞋulini. Fita ada Yemesa wataina Yoni adiꞋitotogaga ginauwedi.
Bana manuwa-abavehawala ana tonagona yana manuweya hiyemu-yo Yesu alika ana butubutu ginogalina, tagiya veꞋalulaukuhi.
Au manuweya giluku gigahedi gigayo, “GavaiꞋona-yo alika ana butubutu ganogalini? Gavadi-yo waveꞋalulaukuhi? Kwamana keke gidaꞋalika, au giꞋenonuwaulu.”
Ada badi hihawavelaigena. Atu Yesu moyaꞋaidi giwavidi be melaleya hihobu au kwamana tamana hinana kadu tomuliya adiꞋitoto Bana buye hiꞋela-ma vetawana kwamana gidauda-ma againe gilukuwedi.
Nimana giꞋabina ada gigahena gigayo, “Talida kumi.” Mena gahe ana kaivila bonadeya ma “Natuku, Iya gagahe umidi.”
Ada auheꞋama kwamana kwamayoku gimidi ginudadana. Ana malamala ma tuwelo. HiꞋita-yo aseꞋasedi giꞋalilihiwana.
Atu Yesu gihawatadi gigayo, “Keke gaveyao wanavenuwaꞋatadi, au gahawatami.” Kadu gigayo, “Tamo aꞋa kwamana wavele be giꞋani.”
